sources.title: Wikidata Korean and English labels of places in South Korea
sources.note: Structured data under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Collected by tools/lexicon/places/collect_places.py (items with country South Korea, coordinates, Korean and English labels); an English label counts only when its Revised Romanization syllables spell the Korean label. Labels are community data, not pronunciation authority; no synthesized audio.
